author: Abouamal Alaoui
content: I highly recommend the Rice and Three. The dishe is made with fresh ingredients that depend on the day's deliveries, which makes the food feel authentic and homemade. At only £6, it's unbeatable value for money. The rice was perfectly cooked, and I chose dal, chicken curry, and lamb curry. The meat was tender, well-cooked, flavorful, and packed with taste. Everything was delicious and full of authentic flavors.
